historical_reviews.v3_1: Offline ROM programming is an attended destructive hardware operation; supplyable package and operator inputs make it conditional rather than inherently blocked.

original_test_intent: Upgrade or downgrade the intended BMC by programming its ROM while the SUT is safely offline, verify programmer success and exactly one reset, then prove BMC and host recovery.
original_method: Identify the board and ROM, authenticate the compatible image and programmer profile, preserve the baseline, isolate power, have a trained operator erase/program/verify the ROM, restore hardware and observe the single reset and full platform recovery.
manual_activity: The owner approves the offline destructive operation and exact artifacts; a trained hardware operator performs power isolation, physical ROM programming, verification and restoration under ESD controls and remains responsible for recovery intervention.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, BMC board revision, ROM device/socket and physical location
Authenticated current/target images and upgrade/downgrade compatibility
Vendor ROM programming procedure, pinout, voltage, adapter and programmer profile
Offline approval, ESD and power-isolation plan
Independent console, known-good ROM and external recovery path
Single-reset definition and post-flash firmware/platform acceptance matrix
safety_requirements: Require explicit destructive/offline approval and a trained operator
Verify board, ROM, image, pinout, voltage, orientation and programmer profile before contact
Preserve immutable pre-flash BMC, host, device, storage and log evidence
Do not infer ROM steps from IPMI or sensor commands
Do not run the duplicate GPU thermal workload
Keep power isolated and follow ESD controls during physical work
Stop on erase/program/verify failure, wrong identity, damage, extra reset or recovery failure
Do not auto-retry or improvise power or board manipulation
agent_execution_scope: Verify provided identities, hashes, compatibility and approval records
Capture protected pre-flash and post-restoration evidence
Monitor programmer output, power, console, BMC, reset timeline and platform health
Automate read-only version, device, storage and log comparison after safe restoration
Do not perform physical programming, choose voltage/profile, clear evidence, retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve image, board/ROM mapping, programmer setup, downtime and recovery
Perform and record physical isolation, erase/program/verify and restoration
Supervise single-reset recovery and own the final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: TEMP_GB_PEX_SW SDR reads and GPU heating belong to the duplicate row and cannot program or validate this ROM.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-approved physical programmer workflow under trained supervision; automation may verify artifacts and collect pre/post recovery evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Offline BMC ROM upgrade/downgrade, one-reset criterion, private version-check script and 15/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the exact board/ROM/image/programmer profile, preserve baseline, physically erase-program-verify offline, restore safely and verify one reset plus full recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the physical identity, electrical/programmer controls, evidence and recovery contract explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Sensor telemetry or an IPMI version read cannot prove physical programming or programmer verification.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong image, pinout, voltage, orientation or profile can damage hardware or leave the BMC unbootable.

project_override_considerations: The project may use its approved programmer and fixture, but must document equivalent board/ROM identity, image authenticity, electrical profile, erase/program/verify evidence, one-reset semantics and recovery; software sensor activity is not an equivalent method.
expected_evidence: Approval, SUT/board/BMC/ROM identity and image hash/signature
Programmer, adapter, profile, voltage, orientation and ESD/power records
Timestamped erase/program/verify output and physical operator record
Exactly one reset and BMC/console/POST/OS recovery timeline
Post-flash version, device, storage, thermal/power and log comparison
Recovery actions if any and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1507 is internally consistent as offline BMC ROM flash. The reused code at row 785 is a separate Source Key and variant; it is isolated rather than treated as a conflict within this row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact hardware, image, programmer, operator and recovery inputs are finite normal project inputs. The operation can proceed conditionally after they are supplied and approved.

review_improvement: Rejects DeepSeek's duplicate-row sensor substitution and defines the physical programming, electrical safety, verification, single-reset and recovery evidence required by the actual source.
independent_technical_reasoning: Offline ROM programming is not an IPMI sensor task. Because it can brick or damage the BMC, automation may verify identities and evidence but cannot choose or perform the physical operation. With an approved package and trained operator it is conditionally executable, so REQUIRES is more accurate than FULLY AUTOMATABLE or BLOCKED.
